name: Wiza
description: Wiza is a B2B sales and recruiting intelligence platform for finding and enriching professional contact and company data, including verified emails, phones and LinkedIn profile details.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned Wiza API key. Agents can read only email, phone, export and API credit balances; professional and company data, reveals, prospecting, enrichment, bulk, lists, webhooks, exports, purchases and raw API access remain blocked.

credentialRequirements.name: WIZA_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: Wiza API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned key from Wiza API settings. Relay encrypts it and permits only the fixed credit-balances read.

capabilities.label: Read credit balances
capabilities.description: Read a reduced snapshot of email, phone, export and API credit balances without accessing professional or company data.

allowed.label: Read credit balances
allowed.description: Read only the connected Wiza account's email, phone, export and API credit balances without accessing professional or company data.

blocked.label: Block people, company, and contact data
blocked.description: Individual reveals, emails, phones, LinkedIn profiles, employment, education, location, social data, prospect search and company enrichment are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block bulk, lists, webhooks, and exports
blocked.description: Bulk enrichment, list creation and retrieval, prospect lists, continued search, webhook delivery, CSV/JSON exports, CRM workflows, integrations, batching and pagination are unavailable.

blocked.label: Block administration, financial actions, and raw access
blocked.description: API-key management, assigned-user changes, credit purchases or allocation, arbitrary endpoints, raw REST, retries, browser sessions, platform credentials and unrestricted tools are unavailable.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The reduced credit-balances read runs automatically. People, company and contact data, bulk, lists, webhooks, exports, financial actions, administration and raw access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same single bounded governance read runs without approval; the full-account API key never expands Relay's fixed credits request.

runtimeSupport.description: Relay mounts exactly one parameterless credit-balances read while Railway alone holds the customer API key.
Relay mounts exactly one parameterless credit-balances read while Railway alone holds the customer API key.

providerSetup.blocker: An active customer Wiza account with API access, an authorized assigned API user, a dedicated API key, current terms/privacy review, Railway staging entry, live credits-schema validation, disconnect rotation and post-rotation denial remain for a separate authorized provider task.
providerSetup.nextAction: An authorized provider task must confirm API access and the governance-only purpose, review current terms and privacy policy, generate a dedicated key for an authorized Wiza API user, store it in Railway staging, and validate only GET https://wiza.co/api/meta/credits. Confirm Bearer authentication, exact numeric-or-unlimited balances, 64 KiB cap, one-request/no-retry behavior, no credit deduction, no professional/company data, encrypted-copy deletion, provider-side rotation and post-rotation denial.

evidence.supports: Wiza documents GET https://wiza.co/api/meta/credits with Bearer API-key authentication and a response containing email, phone, export and API balances, where a balance may use the exact unlimited sentinel.
Wiza requires the customer API key as a Bearer token on every API request and documents 401 handling for missing, invalid, expired or disabled keys.
Wiza documents prepaid API credits deducted for successfully returned LinkedIn profile, email and phone enrichment data. Relay exposes only the balance endpoint and no enrichment action.
Wiza documents individual reveals, prospect search, company enrichment, bulk enrichment, webhooks and legacy list endpoints. Relay blocks every adjacent professional-data operation.
Wiza's current terms govern its APIs, require lawful and privacy-compliant use, prohibit unauthorized scraping and harvesting, and impose payment terms for enrichment, scans and exports.

Wiza's current privacy policy describes its B2B professional contact-enrichment service, personal-information processing, security, retention and data-subject rights. Relay's V1 returns no professional profile data.
